en: Bye, bye, tiny little $r. Raze go now.
You can learn to sew up in Orgrimmar.  That's to the north.  Maybe one of the Orgrimmar Grunts can help you.
For reasons I cannot understand, Elder Thunderhorn has gone to the Slithering Scar in Un'Goro Crater.

$C, the Horde has gathered all that it needs for the Ahn'Qiraj War! Now we wait for the puny Alliance to catch up. When they do, we'll begin transporting everything to Silithus. It should not be long after the buildup there is completed that the war will begin!
Well done. A blow to Arugal no doubt!
If it weren't for the goblins' inconceivable, dumb luck, they'd crash their car during every race!
Where is Elder Darkhorn?
Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.
Welcome to Ironforge, $c.
If it weren't for the Grim Guzzler, I'd spend my free time pulling the wings off dragon whelps.
Yap, I can teach ye to fish.
The spirit of Stonetalon weeps.  It weeps from its mountain peaks, to its rivers, to its severed, dying trees.
Winner! We be havin' a winner here!
Blades of light!
If we fall, then Darrowshire is doomed!

You must do what you think is right, Marcus. We served together under Turalyon. He made us both the men that we are today. Did he err with me? Do you truly believe my intent is to cause harm to our alliance? Would I shame our heroes?
Your search is almost completed.  Seek your truth in the entrance room of Thrall's Fortress in the Valley of Wisdom.

Enjoying the festival, $c? My wares can give an extra kick to your day. Nothing like warm food and drink!$b$bAnd if you haven't tried it yet, get a friend or two and celebrate around the ribbon pole; it's sure to lift your spirits!
It's quiet here....

Hello there, young $c. I am Rathiril Sunlance and I am an elder Magister of the High Order here on Zephras Isle. It's always good to see bright-eyed young shen'dorei, ready to do their duty in service to their homeland.

Don't let this dusty old mage hold you up however, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Feel free to stop by later if you'd like to speak more.
Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.
A very sad tale. Thank you, spirit.

Hello, $n. Should you require assistance in completing your mission, you have only to ask. My guardian, Raze, can assist you in defeating the shadowsilk poachers. Use this Staff of Command to command Raze in battle. He is trained to ONLY attack shadowsilk poachers.
There's a Skinning Trainer in Orgrimmar.  To get there head north up the road out of Razor Hill.  Ask an Orgrimmar Grunt for directions when you arrive.
As long as those dwarves stay over there we'll have no trouble.  Where are you heading $n?
The Snowfall Graveyard is owned by the Horde.
Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.
The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

Hoha! Good to see a fellow blacksmith who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
Where is he? Go next door, to the Arms of Legend. He forges special weapons for great heroes there. Honor him and he may show you how to make the stuff of legends.
Baristolth, I have lost my badge and require a replacement.
Get away from those kegs!
%s starts to chant in an ancient tongue, summoning forth something evil in nature.

In a place called Feralas to the west of here, the hippogryphs, long-time companions of the night elves, are in danger.$B$BI need you to rescue an egg from the ruins of Isildien, to the south, there. The Super Egg-O-Matic can analyze any egg brought to it and judge if it is likely to hatch. I then send the eggs along to the druids, safe from the Gordunni ogres' dark magics.$B$BPlease know, $n, some of the rescued eggs are bad eggs, and will never hatch.
Shhh... it will all be over soon.
My flight is ready! Soldiers come to my aid!
Attack!  For the Horde!
Scarlet Monastery
Protect Foreman Bonds at all costs!
The resultant energies could collapse though, and that could cause an energy flux that would give you a migraine for weeks.
%s whimpers obediently.

After the fall of Dalaran, I took my leave from the Kirin Tor. I spent years watching over Atiesh, only to have my purpose amongst the Kirin Tor taken from me in one fell swoop. I would find the staff, though it might take a lifetime. That is how I came to join the Argent Dawn and why I am here now.

Somewhere to fly to?  You'll need to go to the Undercity for that!  Go south on the road out of town, then southwest to the Ruins of Lordaeron.  You can catch the elevator down to the Undercity from the back of the ruins and once there ask an Undercity Guardian for more specific directions.
You've got my attention.
I am a BOT. I have tons of information. To find out what I know whisper me
